test_results.observation: The focused target and build contract passed 60 of 60 cases; unsafe authority, capability, and worker-binding categories remained rejected.
Ordinary local login rendered without a runtime configuration error; a throttled public-demo first load exposed only loading text before the disabled-capability login became ready.
The real build matrix, recursive artifact assertions, immutable diff check, cached candidate scan, and local image checks all passed.
Loading exposed no application controls; recovery, reset, and call routes shared one unavailable state; the disabled authenticated-chat fixture had no upload or call control.
Missing, malformed, old-version, future-version, and wrong-target documents all converged on the same unavailable UI at login and the direct call route.
Upload controls changed from zero to two without rebuilding; both fixtures reported the exact same dist digest, fixed-disabled capabilities remained absent, and no upload request was issued.

Client tests passed 280 of 280 and server tests passed 492 with five expected skips; preservation tests passed and no controller, server socket handler, message schema, or conversation schema changed.
Every required local gate passed, all retained screenshot digests resolved, the candidate helper returned the approved tree, both loopback ports were released, and D2 mutations remained zero.

notes: All eight observations passed. The run remains blocked only for explicit maintainer acceptance. D2_MUTATIONS=0.
